bug_semantics: Stored XSS in the cama_contact_form plugin. A low-privileged authenticated user reaches the contact-form admin edit endpoint (which lacked role-appropriate authorization) and persists attacker-controlled markup into the form record: the markup-by-contract settings fields (before_html / after_html) and the form-builder field definitions/labels stored in contact_forms.value and contact_forms.settings. When any page embedding the [forms slug=...] shortcode renders, the plugin's rendering pipeline emits these stored values unescaped (raw), so the injected script executes in every visitor's browser with same-origin privileges against the admin panel, enabling admin-account creation, cookie theft, and session takeover.
flaw_origin: The rendering pipeline itself is the flaw and was first written in this repo's root commit 671a7ed178c7265e4c5d33d805a9b3a8cd7b3db6 ('Version 1.0', 2015-07-09): app/apps/plugins/contact_form/views/forms_shorcode.html.erb emits <%= raw r[:before_form] %>, <%= raw form_element_bootstrap_object(r[:form], values[:fields]) %> and <%= raw r[:after_form] %>, while app/apps/plugins/contact_form/contact_form_html_helper.rb#form_element_bootstrap_object assembles form markup by unescaped Ruby string interpolation (labels, custom classes, field_options.template, to_attr_format output). This is a markup-by-contract design with no sanitization boundary before raw emission. The plugin was later extracted to the separate gem owen2345/cama_contact_form in cb8f500efcb6d9038711155b8cb68d12ba097b69 (2016-05-18, which also added the gemspec dependency 'cama_contact_form') and released as gem 0.1.0 (2022); the gem's rendering of the railscf_mail previous_html/before_html and after_html wrapper fields kept the same raw-emission design, and camaleon-cms releases through 2.9.1 pinned the vulnerable gem (Gemfile.lock at tag 2.9.1: cama_contact_form (~> 0.1.0), cama_contact_form (0.1.0)). The literal field name 'before_html' exists only in the extracted gem, not in this repo's trees (git grep of every checked tag returns zero hits), but the causal mechanism - raw emission of stored form markup plus an under-authorized edit path - descends from the root commit's code.

reasoning: Vulnerability lifecycle: the raw-emission rendering design shipped in the repo's very first commit (2015), the plugin was extracted to the cama_contact_form gem (2016) whose 0.1.0 gem kept the design and added the before_html markup field, every release through 2.9.1 pinned that vulnerable gem, and researchers (Amir Aliu & Enrik Mustafa) demonstrated stored XSS via before_html through the under-authorized edit endpoint; the vendor remediation (ab240651 in this repo, PR owen2345/cama_contact_form#63 / release 0.1.10 upstream) adds escape-on-output plus save-time sanitization gated by an admin-only permission, shipping in 2.9.3.
